title: Monotonicity of three-sign majority
statement: Order the signs by $-1<1$ and order triples coordinatewise. The function that returns $1$ when the sum of the three signs is nonnegative and returns $-1$ otherwise is monotone: if one triple is coordinatewise at most another, its output is at most the other's output.
